## SOB enrollment

```{r}

### plot for policies by state

state_policy_enrollment <- lapply(2010:2025, function(year){
  print(year)
  data_w_names <- read.csv(here("data/PRF_sob/sobcov_2024_names.csv"))
  column_names <- colnames(data_w_names)
  
  year_2 <- substr(as.character(year), 3, 4)
  data <- read.csv(here(paste0("data/PRF_sob/raw_files/sobcov", year_2, ".txt")),
                   sep = '|')
  names(data) <- column_names
  
  data_prf <- data %>%
    filter(Commodity.Code ==  88) %>% 
    filter(Insurance.Plan.Code == 13)
  
  print(unique(data_prf$Quantity.Type))
  
  state_sums <- data_prf %>%
    group_by(Location.State.Abbreviation) %>%
    summarize(total = sum(Policies.Sold.Count, na.rm = TRUE),
              total_acres = sum(Net.Reported.Quantity, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  state_sums$year <- year
  
  return(state_sums)
  
}) %>% do.call("rbind", .)


all_states <- unique(state_policy_enrollment$Location.State.Abbreviation)
years <- 2010:2025

# Expand the data to ensure every state-year combination is present
state_policy_enrollment <- state_policy_enrollment %>%
  complete(Location.State.Abbreviation = all_states, year = years, fill = list(total = 0))

state_policy_enrollment <- state_policy_enrollment %>% rename(State = Location.State.Abbreviation,
                                                              Policies = total)

state_policy_enrollment[["year"]] <- as.Date(paste0(state_policy_enrollment[["year"]], "-01-01"))
```

```{r}


state_policy_sum <- state_policy_enrollment %>%
  group_by(State) %>%
  summarise(total_policies = sum(Policies, na.rm = TRUE))

state_acres_sum <- state_policy_enrollment %>%
  group_by(State) %>%
  summarise(total_acres = sum(total_acres, na.rm = TRUE))


```

```{r}


options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

#-----------------------------
# 1. Get CONUS States
#-----------------------------
states_conus <- states(cb = TRUE, resolution = "20m") %>%
  filter(!STUSPS %in% c("AK", "HI", "PR")) %>%
  st_transform(4326)  # WGS84

#-----------------------------
# 2. Ensure all states are represented
#-----------------------------
states_map <- states_conus %>%
  left_join(
    state_acres_sum,
    by = c("STUSPS" = "State")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total_acres = ifelse(is.na(total_acres), 0, total_acres)
  )

#-----------------------------
# 3. Create Acreage Bins
#-----------------------------
# Adjusted bins: 0 = white, 1-1M, 1M-10M, etc.
breaks <- c(0, 1, 1e6, 1e7, 5e7, 1e8, Inf)
labels <- c(
  "0",
  "1 – 1M",
  "1M – 10M",
  "10M – 50M",
  "50M – 100M",
  "100M+"
)

states_map <- states_map %>%
  mutate(
    acres_bin = cut(
      total_acres,
      breaks = breaks,
      labels = labels,
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      right = FALSE
    )
  )

#-----------------------------
# 4. Plot Map
#-----------------------------
p_prf_acres <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = states_map, aes(fill = acres_bin), color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(
    name = "Total PRF Acres\n(2010–2025)",
    option = "C",
    direction = -1,
    na.value = "white"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Total PRF Enrollment Acres by State",
    subtitle = "2010–2025",
    caption = "Source: RMA PRF Program"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

p_prf_acres

png(here("data/outputs/figures/p_prf_acres.png"),
    width = 1000,
    height = 600)
plot(p_prf_acres)
dev.off()


```

## USDM D4 map

```{r}


options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)  # cache shapefiles locally

#-----------------------------
# 1. Read RMA Grid
#-----------------------------
grid <- st_read(here("data/rainfall_index_grids/official_RMA_RI_grid.shp"), quiet = TRUE) %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  mutate(grid_id = row_number())

#-----------------------------
# 2. Read USDM Files
#-----------------------------
usdm_files <- list.files(
  here("data/USDM_GIS"),
  pattern = "\\.shp$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)


# Extract YYYY from filename
file_years <- str_extract(basename(usdm_files), "^USDM_(\\d{4})") %>%
  str_remove("USDM_") %>%
  as.numeric()

# Keep only 2010–2025
usdm_files <- usdm_files[file_years >= 2010 & file_years <= 2025]

length(usdm_files)  # sanity check

# Get CRS from first USDM file
usdm_crs <- st_crs(st_read(usdm_files[1], quiet = TRUE))
grid <- st_transform(grid, usdm_crs)

#-----------------------------
# 3. Function to Calculate D4 Indicator Per Week
#-----------------------------
process_week <- function(file) {
  print(file)
  usdm <- st_read(file, quiet = TRUE) %>%
    st_make_valid()
  
  # Keep only D4 polygons
  usdm_d4 <- usdm %>%
    filter(DM == "4")   # change if your column name differs
  
  # If no D4 this week
  if (nrow(usdm_d4) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(
      grid_id = grid$grid_id,
      D4_week = 0
    ))
  }
  
  # Intersection test
  intersects <- st_intersects(grid, usdm_d4, sparse = FALSE)
  
  data.frame(
    grid_id = grid$grid_id,
    D4_week = as.integer(rowSums(intersects) > 0)
  )
}

#-----------------------------
# 4. Apply Across All Weeks
#-----------------------------
d4_results <- map_dfr(usdm_files, process_week)

#-----------------------------
# 5. Calculate Percent of Time in D4
#-----------------------------
d4_summary <- d4_results %>%
  group_by(grid_id) %>%
  summarise(
    D4_percent = mean(D4_week) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Join back to spatial grid
grid <- grid %>%
  left_join(d4_summary, by = "grid_id")

#-----------------------------
# 7. CONUS States (tigris)
#-----------------------------
states <- states(cb = TRUE, resolution = "20m") %>%  # generalized = faster
  filter(!STUSPS %in% c("AK", "HI", "PR")) %>%
  st_transform(st_crs(grid))
#-----------------------------
# 7. Plot
#-----------------------------

#-----------------------------
# Create CONUS mask
#-----------------------------
conus_states <- states(cb = TRUE, resolution = "20m") %>%
  filter(!STUSPS %in% c("AK", "HI", "PR")) %>%
  st_transform(st_crs(grid))

conus_union <- st_union(conus_states)

# Clip grid to CONUS boundary
sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)

grid <- st_intersection(grid, conus_union)

p_usdm <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = grid, aes(fill = D4_percent), color = NA) +
  geom_sf(data = states, fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    name = "% Time in D4",
    option = "C",
    direction = -1,
    na.value = "white"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Percent of Time in Exceptional Drought (D4)",
    subtitle = "USDM Weekly Reports (2010–2025)",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Drought Monitor"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p_usdm


```
